# Dockerfile fixtures

- `buildkit/`: BuildKit's parser test files (`frontend/dockerfile/parser/testfiles` and
  `testfiles-negative`, Dockerfiles only) from moby/buildkit at
  cd8ee2441a4cb4d29f816bab2b009eac131784d7, Apache License 2.0 (`buildkit/LICENSE`).
- `real/`: Dockerfiles from docker/awesome-compose (CC0 1.0) at
  30f4b7f6a6c3b0c0ecf4d4efb0de203c48d11562, docker-library/python (MIT) at
  f4c67ece208dead594e43628d22e3c6027dd97ab, docker-library/php (MIT) at
  5ec2a6a0dad498e89a91a39454dbb52e98ce2bdb, nginx/docker-nginx (BSD-2-Clause) at
  d99174e2cecfc7e5db51c05aff54c2c9dee45803 and moby/buildkit (Apache 2.0), each with its licence.
- `generated/`: generated by `generated/generate.py` (seed 99, 300 files).

`expected.jsonl` is BuildKit's parse of every file (tests/iac_real/dockerfile).
